title: Babe Matthews's finale, and Joe's mimicry that annoyed her
summary: Babe Thomas recalls following Billie Holiday at the Terrace, her "I nominate Fletcher Henderson" finale that stopped the show, and how a trumpeter, Joe, kept mimicking her lisp.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, no, when you come out on this stage?

I came into the Terrace, the Grand Terrace, I followed Billie in the Terrace. At that time, I am very happy to state that I was very, very young and happy about the whole thing. but I had a very bad lisp. I lisped quite a bit so I'd known Roy since I was a kid of 15. And, so we had a finale in the Terrace the first time, and I might add in all these

years of show business the only time I've ever seen -- I imagine it might have happened at some other time someplace else -- it was the only time I've ever seen a finale stop the show cold. Stop the show. So, this finale stopped the show stone cold to the point that we changed shows out there at that particular time every six weeks. We kept the finale in because the finale stopped the show ... It was on Christopher Columbus and on Fletcher Henderson but at that time there was like principals, what we call principals, and chorus girls. Well, the principals would come, each principal would come out. Say, they'd pick 4 or 5 principals out of the show and each one when the finale hit, a principal would come out and they would say, "I nominate Duke Ellington" and they'd do their little bit and go back.
The Duke was at the Congress at the time.

Yes, he was. Then another principle would come out and "I'd nominate Cab Calloway for king of swing." And another one would come out, I nominate Jimmy Lunceford for king of swing. Now I'm the last one to come on. Chorus girls are on stage already. It's all in tempo to the tune of "Christopher Columbus" which was Fletcher's theme song and was very big at that particular time. Thank you. That's just what it was. So, now they bring me on. The band is steady going, boom, boom (singing tune) so I would come on and I would say in lisp -- I don't lisp anymore unless I'm angry with Joe Thomas. I fall

right back into it at this late stage of the game if I'm angry but I don't lisp anymore. But, at that time I lisped and I'd come on and I'd say, 'I nominate Fletcher Henderson who made Christopher the thing. I think he should be crowned king of thwing' [BINGS] swing. And the band would go and while they're playing I would back up to the bandstand and get Fletcher, take him by the arm and he and I would come down front to the tempo of Christopher Columbus. But, in the meantime, what I'm trying to say, Roy would mimmic me when I would come out on the floor. Now I've known Roy ...

Eldridge. I didn't mind Roy mimmicking me because like I said, I've known Roy since I was 15 years old so I knew Roy's voice and I didn't mind it. But, all of a sudden out of the blue one night I'm saying, I nominate Fletcher Henderson and I get this strange voice mimmicking me. Well, I let it go for about a week or two and it bugged me. So, during an intermission ...

It's the truth. During an intermission one night, Roy was standing out front. I came out and I got Roy over in a corner. I said, Roy, I know you've been mimmicking me when I come on in the finale but I'm getting a strange voice from the bandstand. I knew Chu's voice. I knew Chu Berry's voice.

Couple of other fellows in the band but this voice I didn't know. So, Roy said that's Joe Thomas, the other trumpeter. I said, What do you mean the other trumpeter? There are three up there. And at that time, there was Roy Eldridge, Dick Vance and Joe Thomas.
That was Dick Vance, Joe Thomas and Roy Eldridge, 1st, 2nd and 3rd.

Well, I had it wrong but you three were there and I didn't know Dick Vance either but it wasn't Dick, it was Joe. So, anyway I said to Roy, Do me a favor. Please tell him not to mimic me when I go on the floor because I don't know him and I don't appreciate anybody mimicking me. You can get away with it. Him, whichever one it is, he said, I'll point him out to you. I said, Don't bother. It's not necessary. because I don't like him. But, anyway, to make a long story short, Stanley, he kept right on doing it.

Oh, yes, he did. And, that made a great dislike in my mind. I didn't go for him at all. So, all right, one night I come out and he introduces himself to me. Now, I'd look up at the band and I know which one is Joe Thomas. That don't make me like him. I asked Roy to tell him to stop. I don't know whether Roy ever did or not. Roy said he did. But, anyway he didn't stop.
